instruction: I want to make the course aims more prominent in this outline. Please apply bold formatting to all text in the first paragraph of the document.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires applying bold formatting to all text in the first paragraph. The evaluator checks if all runs in the first paragraph have bold=True. Verified by reading the document structure - first paragraph exists at index 0 and contains course aims.

Verification logic is correct: iterates through all runs in first paragraph and checks if run.font.bold is True
Complete coverage: checks ALL text runs in the first paragraph, matching the instruction requirement
Proper edge case handling: checks for empty document, empty paragraph, no runs, and only verifies non-empty runs
